run_FalAITextToImageTask: run text-to-image generation using the FalAITextToImageTask class with prompt and optional image size parameters
run_FalAIAutomaticSpeechRecognitionTask: run automatic speech recognition on audio input via URL or file path using the FalAIAutomaticSpeechRecognitionTask class
run_FalAITextToVideoTask: run text-to-video generation using the FalAITextToVideoTask class with async queue polling for completion
run_FalAIImageToImageTask: run image-to-image transformation with optional LoRA adapter weights using the FalAIImageToImageTask class
run_FalAIImageSegmentationTask: run image segmentation to produce mask output using the FalAIImageSegmentationTask class with async queue polling
